summary.zh: 基因组上是熊，食性却几乎完全是竹子。
summary.en: Genetically a bear, yet almost entirely a bamboo eater.

field_marks.zh: 黑白相间的毛色，圆脸，前掌有伪拇指。
field_marks.en: Black-and-white coat, round face and a pseudo-thumb on the forepaw.

story.zh: 基因组测序证实熊猫属于熊科。负责鲜味受体的基因 Tas1r1 在熊猫中失去功能，时间大致与它转为吃竹子的时期吻合。肉食祖先的消化系统几乎未变。
story.en: Genome sequencing confirmed pandas are bears. The umami receptor gene Tas1r1 was pseudogenised, roughly coinciding with the dietary switch to bamboo. The digestive system is still that of a carnivore.

notes.zh: 成都等地的繁育研究基地是最稳妥的观察点，早晨喂食时段最活跃。野外几乎不可能偶遇。
notes.en: Breeding centres such as Chengdu are the practical places to watch pandas, most active in the morning feeding hours. Wild encounters are very unlikely.

etiquette.zh: 遵守工作人员指示，不使用闪光灯，不投喂。
etiquette.en: Follow staff instructions, no flash and no feeding.
